items.title: Trump won't extend Iran ceasefire, threatens to 'bomb' Oman if it 'gets in the way'
items.summary: Shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz sank to a new low as a ceasefire between the U.S. and Iran is set to expire on Monday with no deal in sight.

items.title: Bolivia Ups Diesel Costs for Big Buyers to Tame Supply Shock
items.summary: Bolivia’s government raised diesel prices 84% for larger consumers of the key industrial fuel, following shortages that caused long lines at gas stations.
